sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272276 (+ /rates and the public per-site search catalog)

values.note: 48 sites with level gravel pads, five of them tent-only, plus group Loop C with a reservable ramada. 36 RV sites list a 60-ft maximum on recreation.gov. Up to 2 camping units per site, each paying the nightly fee.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272276 ('a 48-site campground that has spacious and level gravel parking pads that accommodate RVs, camper trailers and tents. Of the 48 sites, there are five sites that are specifically designated for tents') + recreation.gov public campsite catalog (36 RV NONELECTRIC sites max vehicle length 60 ft), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272276 (notice: 'There is no power available on site for campers and generators are only allowed from 7:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water in peak season (BLM: 'As of January 2025, there is no running water at the site'). No dump station. Fish cleaning station; boat slips complimentary for registered campers.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272276 ('There is potable water provided throughout the campground and day use areas', 'men's and women's vault toilets located in each loop', notice 'There is no black or gray water dump on site', amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)') + https://www.blm.gov/visit/devils-elbow-campground ('Boat slip complimentary for registered campers', 'As of January 2025, there is no running water at the site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The description says 'All sites are reservation only', but a recreation.gov notice says 'First-come, first-served sites are available in this campground' and the rate table has walk-in seasons in April and October-November around the May-September reservation season. You must occupy the site every reserved night and cannot change sites. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am. 14 nights in a rolling 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272276 (description, notices, maxStay 14 nights rolling 30 days) + /rates ('Peak Season' 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30; 'First-come, First-served Season' 2026-04-01 to 04-30 and 2026-10-01 to 11-30), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM (Butte Field Office) recreation area on the Devil's Elbow of Hauser Lake, ~12 mi NE of Helena off York Road (paved); every site looks over the lake, but there is little shade. Concrete boat launch with courtesy dock, small beach; marina, store with gas and a bar/restaurant half a mile away. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + BLM page: confirmed 48 sites (5 tent), no electric, potable water (peak season), vault toilets, recreation.gov booking, $25/night (2026-2028 rate tables; fees left as checked). Added 60-ft max on 36 RV sites, no dump station, 14-night max. Cleared fcfs 'never': a notice and walk-in rate seasons (Apr, Oct-Nov) contradict 'reservation only'. Season not stated (rate seasons only). Note trimmed of restated values.
